newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE close off highs on trade buying.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE close off highs on trade buying.

text.p: White sugar futures backed off the day's highs set earlier but still manage to close positively on Wednesday.
Outright trade purchases mainly accounted for the steadiness of the two nearby contracts during the afternoon although commission houses were active buyers earlier, they said.
"There's nothing out of the ordinary and it's all trade buying," said one trader, noting flat price purchases on both nearby positions.
"There is offtake around, especially at these levels which are slightly more attractive," he said, citing demand in Iran, Indonesia and Pakistan.
At the close March was up 60 cents at $294.70 after firming to an intraday high of $297.00. May was up $1.30 at $295.60.
March accounted for 1,626 lots and May 1,554 lots, boosted by limited crosses and dealings on the March/May spread.
Paris positions were all slightly firmer. March closed up $1.30 cents at $295.00 and May was up 80 cents at $295.50.
